archetypes.name: bash-state
archetypes.rationale: The diff heavily changes sourced Bash libraries, traps, shell options, HOME/PATH-dependent helpers, and env-file state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the Bash control flow for source-vs-execute behavior, trap installation, set -euo interactions, subshell boundaries, and variable restoration. Pay special attention to functions used from tests or release prompts that may run with unset HOME, altered PATH, or sourced-only contexts. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: release-step7
archetypes.rationale: The release path now depends on root-resolution ordering, captured upgrade output, and cross-step restart state.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /release Step 7 and Step 8 integration for whether the documented snippets are implementable, source the expected helper, choose the correct active cache root, and persist restart state reliably. Check whether failure paths avoid stale state while still warning and continuing after the release is already published. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sparse-install
archetypes.rationale: The change introduces a shared sparse allowlist and splits script-root allowlist authority from installed-root cache authority.
archetypes.prompt_body: Evaluate the sparse-install architecture across the new allowlist library, upgrade script, SessionStart probe, tests, and docs. Look for places where SCRIPT_ROOT, PLUGIN_ROOT, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, marketplace clone paths, or cache roots could be conflated or sourced from the wrong tree. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: hook-failopen
archetypes.rationale: SessionStart hook changes add environment-sensitive probing that must remain non-mutating, cwd-independent, and fail-open.
archetypes.prompt_body: Assess the SessionStart sparse-cone drift probe for fail-open behavior, fixed-string advisory safety, read-only operation, and isolation from HOOK_CWD or untrusted local output. Check whether shell-option restoration and parent-shell message mutation behave correctly under errors, missing tools, missing HOME, and malformed sourced libraries. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: harness-realism
archetypes.rationale: The expanded harness stubs CLI behavior and may pass without faithfully exercising the production release and upgrade contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new and modified shell harnesses for realism, isolation, and false-positive risks. Focus on whether stubs match actual claude, gh, git sparse-checkout, env -i, and source-time behavior closely enough to catch the intended regressions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
